content: कबलम् A kind of natural fodder (fed to elephants), consisting of branches and leaves of certain trees; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 11. 27</ls>. The word occurs sometimes in a ‘Dvandva compound’ with ‘kubala’ which also means the fodder which reduces phlegm and gall. <ab>cf.</ab> कबलं नामतस्तत्तु वातलं कफपित्तहृत् .
